sources.scope: CO only; 15 country-tagged surnames, snapshot of Wikipedia published surname tables (July 2023)
sources.use: Preserved ranked family-name spellings and Latin diacritics; entries selected before secondary source
sources.license_note: Repository describes dataset as CC0; upstream table provenance requires independent review

sources.scope: CO only; directory-derived surname-labelled entries, locatefamily.com snapshot (July 2019)
sources.use: Additional source-observed entries; numeric percentages deliberately discarded; require occurrence in at least one other batch-D country and exclude known first names, entity labels and invalid entries
sources.limitations: Country evidence is a noisy directory and not official Colombia vital statistics; individual validation and licensing review required before production.
sources.expansion_filter: For new 2,500: original Colombia country-coded directory surname entry AND independent surname appearances in at least 2 of Argentina RENAPER (2021), Mexico SEP (2012), Chile electoral (2020). Remove known first names and organization words; do not treat non-Colombia sources as country attestation.
